cohort: Extremely preterm infants whose plasma samples were collected in the first 72 hours of life and who were later assessed for bronchopulmonary dysplasia.
finding: Alterations in plasma proteins are detectable from 4 hours of age in extremely preterm infants who later develop BPD, and these protein biomarkers, when combined with birth characteristics, show potential to predict BPD development within the first 72 hours of life.
followup_time: N/A (outcome of BPD observed later, but specific follow-up duration not stated)

gest_age: Extremely preterm (specific range not provided, but typically <28 weeks gestational age).
